title: 2078. Declaring and Printing Variables of Different Data Types
description:
ssions
2078
. 
Declaring and Printing Variables of Different Data Types
10
Easy
Problem Statement
Read an integer, a float, and a character, then print each of them back on its own line.
Description
Declare variables of type int, float, and char. Read one value of each type using scanf with the appropriate format specifiers, then print each value using printf with the matching format specifier. This uses only variables, assignment, and printf/scanf — no loops or conditions are needed.
Input Description
An integer, a float, and a character, separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the integer, then the float (2 decimal places), then the character, each on its own line.
Sample Input
25 3.14 A
Sample Output
25
3.14
A
